tapsPerFlow.label: Console home: the phone is the remote
Rocket Crew mission 6 → Bake Shop day 4, every device
Changed our minds: back to Rocket Crew
Word Duel: Nana's game, play CRANE, back to the list
A new Hearthisle night across three homes, while turn 14 waits
Next Friday 8:00: resume turn 14, our roll, pause again
A push on Dad's phone → the move → next game waiting, across games
Friday night: who's here, Play on TV, devices join by name
First run: the TV, who plays here (stickers), pair the kids' iPads
Bake Shop: start a new bakery, keeping day 4
A move arrives while Home is open
The cloud picture freezes mid mission 6; it comes back at mission 6 (0 kid taps, 1 phone tap)
Jonathan's phone dies mid mission 6; Mom's phone picks up the remote, nothing restarts
Two phones saved Bake Shop day 4 differently: pick one, the other is kept, change your mind
The Okafors drop at Hearthisle turn 15; the host holds the board; they come back
